summary_en: 3,000,000 shares (1.67% of S/O) up to ¥5.127B via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-07-31 at ¥1,709/share. Single-day execution window. Part of 4,000,000-share (2.22% S/O) ¥7.1B program authorized 2026-04-30 through 2026-12-31; 428,700 shares (¥737.6M) acquired cumulatively to 2026-07-30.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: MAX Co., Ltd. (ticker 6454, TSE Prime) filed notice on 2026-07-30 of a single-day off-hours buyback block under its April 2026 share repurchase authorization. The block targets 3,000,000 shares (1.67% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for up to ¥5.127 billion via ToSTNeT-3 trading on 2026-07-31 at the closing price of ¥1,709 per share. The execution is a mandatory-limit order during a specific 8:45 AM time window only; no changes to execution method or timing are permitted. This block is one execution under the broader April 2026 board resolution authorizing acquisition of up to 4,000,000 shares (2.22% of S/O) for up to ¥7.1 billion through 2026-12-31 using off-hours and open-market methods. As of 2026-07-30, the company had cumulatively acquired 428,700 shares for ¥737.6 million under the program.
